answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 7852 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Assalamo Alaikum! I am a Pakistani living in Saudi Arabia. I live in Riyadh. Our 'Meeqat' is 'seel Al-Kabir'. If we go with Umrah Group, they stop at Meeqat for Ahram, but if we go by public transport from Riyadh to Makkah. They do not stop at Meeqat. In such case, what should we do? Can we go to Makkah directly and after putting our luggage there, can we go to Ayesha Mosque to put on Ahram for Umrah. Please give the detailed answer. Question: Assalamo Alaikum! I am a Pakistani living in Saudi Arabia. I live in Riyadh. Our 'Meeqat' is 'seel Al-Kabir'. If we go with Umrah Group, they stop at Meeqat for Ahram, but if we go by public transport from Riyadh to Makkah. They do not stop at Meeqat. In such case, what should we do? Can we go to Makkah directly and after putting our luggage there, can we go to Ayesha Mosque to put on Ahram for Umrah. Please give the detailed answer. Answer ID: 7852 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1606/1524=D/1429) In case of going by public transport, if there is no time of wearing Ihram by having a halt at Meeqat , you should wear Ihram in Riyaz before you get on board from there and perform two rakah, but you should not make the intention of Ihram until you are reach nearer to Meeqat then you make the intention of Ihram . It is not permissible to cross Meeqat without wearing Ihram . If you go directly to Makkah Mukarramah, you have to return to any Meeqat like Taif or Jeddah etc and wear Ihram; otherwise you will have to offer dum (qurbani). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
